# Department calculator calibration

Planned, awaiting a named CA who runs and captures the department calculator. No captured cases have been supplied. Synthetic mechanics and source-calculator tests are not independent tax calibration and must not be labelled as it.

Manual path: the CA records the supported typed inputs and exact output minor units through `venture.ca.differential.add`. That app-only action records who captured the case, membership and time. A maintainer then reviews and commits the exported capture as a fixture before claiming calibration.

`known-differences.json` is intentionally empty. An accepted difference must bind case name, output key, both exact amounts, a short verbatim rule quote and its official Income Tax Department source. A fresh difference must fail `runDifferential` until the CA reviews it. Never fill this directory with invented departmental output.
